eyebrow: Organizing the toolkit in source control
code:
dba-toolkit/
├── README.md                 -- one line per script
├── health/
│   ├── server-health-check.sql
│   └── database-space-check.sql
├── backups-and-jobs/
│   └── backup-status-and-failed-jobs.sql
└── incident-response/
    └── blocking-and-long-running-queries.sql
caption: The README is the index you actually read during an incident.

code:
# Commit when a script changes -- explain why, not just what
git commit -m "backup-status: add @DatabaseName filter"

# Re-verify after an upgrade, update the header, commit that too
git commit -m "server-health-check: re-verified on SQL 2022"
caption: Git history turns "I think this still works" into "here's the commit that proves it."
